value.name: agree to give her the week
value.description: Daniel is told he can have the week, and he thanks the speaker for it.

value.name: share coffee in silence
value.description: Daniel and Rosa drink coffee together without speaking for a while.
evidence: They drank their coffee. They did not say anything else for some time.

value.name: Daniel reflects on his past self
value.description: Before leaving, Daniel tells Rosa he wishes he had been a different kind of man over the last twenty years.
evidence: At ten to four Daniel stood and put on his coat and looked down at her.
"Rosa," he said. "If I had been a different kind of man for the last twenty years."

value.name: Rosa reframes Daniel's change
value.description: Rosa tells Daniel he has been the man he was, and that the real issue is the different man he may be becoming now.
evidence: "You were not a different kind of man for the last twenty years. You were the kind of man you were. You are becoming, possibly, a different kind of man now. That is the thing in front of you. The other thing is not."

value.name: Rosa advises Daniel to stay away tonight
value.description: Rosa urges Daniel not to return to the house that night and to give her the evening.
evidence: "Go home, Daniel. Or go to your sister. Or go for a walk. Do not go back to the house tonight. Give her the evening."

value.name: Daniel leaves the bakery
value.description: Daniel departs after agreeing to Rosa's advice.

value.name: Rosa sits alone and reflects
value.description: Rosa remains at the table, finishes her coffee and biscotto, and realizes she has completed something she has prepared for thirty-one years.
evidence: Rosa sat at the table for another twenty minutes. She finished her coffee and she ate the biscotto and she watched the door of the bakery open and close several times for several different customers, and she thought, with a clarity she had not expected, that she had just done a thing she had been preparing to do for thirty-one years and that she did not know what she was going to do with the rest of the time she had been preparing.

value.name: Rosa walks home by a longer route
value.description: Rosa leaves the bakery and walks home along Tenth Street and Pine, taking the long way past a small park.
evidence: She walked home along Tenth Street and turned east on Pine and went the long way past the small park
value.location_hint: Tenth Street and Pine; small park

value.name: Rosa watches child and dog play
value.description: At the park, Rosa stops to watch an unknown child throw a tennis ball for an unknown dog, and the dog catches it despite the bad throw.
evidence: she stopped for a moment to watch them, and the child threw the ball badly and the dog caught it anyway

value.name: Rosa nearly cries
value.description: Watching the child and dog, Rosa is unexpectedly moved to the point of almost crying.
evidence: and Rosa was surprised to find that she was, herself, almost crying
